Name: Selvax Pty Ltd

Our lead candidate combines two immunological agents, which are administered directly into the tumour site causing regression of solid tumours (including chemotherapy-resistant) with minimal toxic side effects.

The complete tumour clearance rates achieved in small animal models with eight different solid tumours ranged from 90% for colorectal cancer to 30% for renal cancers.  Data showed no tumour recurrence for the life of the animal and clearance of a second tumour in another part of the body (abscopal metastatic model). 

An animal health product also being developed for treating dogs with cancer has achieved positive results in a trial conducted in collaboration with Perth Veterinary Specialists, a specialist oncology clinic.

The Selvax approach differs from standard chemotherapy and radiological treatments in that its goal is to stimulate the patient’s own immune system to kill the cancer. The treatment effectively acts as a 'vaccine' against recurrence of the cancer.

Name: PLSTC
Description:
Most of the world’s microplastic pollution comes from the clothes we discard.

When they lie buried in landfills, they release plastic fibres that make their way into the water we drink, the food we eat and the air we breathe. Although plastic is man-made, a natural process can break it down and return it to the Earth.

PLSTC has designed and bio-engineered naturally occurring bacteria with the power to transform plastic waste into edible food, resulting in reduced pollution and a revolutionary shift of the food supply chain.

It works a little something like this: a plastic garment is “fed” to PLSTC’s bio-engineered bacteria. The bacteria then eat away at the plastic, gradually breaking it down into its basic chemical components. When the bacteria have done their bit, the plastic waste has been converted into synthetic proteins, carbohydrates and fats.

Full of nutrients and ready to be served. Bon appetite.

Description:
Syntara Limited (ASX:SNT) is a clinical stage drug development company targeting extracellular matrix dysfunction with its world-leading expertise in amine oxidase chemistry and other technologies to develop novel medicines for blood cancers and conditions linked to inflammation and fibrosis.

Syntara is managing three phase 2 clinical studies in diseases of high unmet need with a further two potential phase 1c/2 studies being evaluated for 2024. Lead candidate SNT‐5505 is for the bone marrow cancer myelofibrosis which causes a build-up of scar tissue that leads to loss of red and white blood cells and platelets. SNT-5505 has already achieved FDA Orphan Drug Designation and clearance under an Investigational New Drug Application for development in myelofibrosis.  After encouraging phase 2a trial results when used as a monotherapy in myelofibrosis, SNT-5505 is now being studied with a JAK inhibitor in a further phase 2 myelofibrosis study with interim data by Q4 2024. The protocol for another phase 1c/2 study with SNT-5505 in patients with a blood cancer called myelodysplastic syndrome is in development and expected to commence recruitment in 2H 2024.

Syntara is also advancing both oral and topical pan-LOX inhibitors in scar prevention and scar modification programs as part of an ongoing collaboration with Professor Fiona Wood and the University of Western Australia.  SNT‐4728 is being studied in collaboration with Parkinson’s UK as a best-in-class SSAO/MAOB inhibitor to treat sleep disorders and slow progression of neurodegenerative diseases like Parkinson’s by reducing neuroinflammation. 
 
Other Syntara drug candidates target fibrotic and inflammatory diseases such as kidney fibrosis, NASH, pulmonary fibrosis and cardiac fibrosis.

Syntara developed two respiratory products available in world markets (Bronchitol for cystic fibrosis and Aridol- a lung function test), for which it receives royalties.

Name: Actinogen Medical
Description:
Actinogen Medical (ASX:ACW) is an ASX-listed biotechnology company developing a novel therapy for neurological and neuropsychiatric diseases associated with dysregulated brain cortisol.
 
There is a strong association between persistent stress and the production of excess cortisol that leads to changes in the brain affecting memory, cognitive function, behaviour and neuropsychological symptoms.
 
Actinogen’s lead compound, Xanamem, has been specifically designed to reduce production of intracellular cortisol - the stress hormone - through the inhibition of the 11β-HSD1 enzyme in the brain. The 11β-HSD1 enzyme is highly concentrated in the areas of the brain associated with cognitive impairment in early Alzheimer’s Disease (AD) and Depression, and other neurological and psychiatric diseases. Because of its ability to reach these areas of the brain and inhibit this enzyme, Xanamem is very different from other treatments for cognitive impairment.
 
Actinogen has studied 11β-HSD1 inhibition by Xanamem in more than 300 volunteers and patients, so far finding a statistically significant improvement in working memory and attention, compared with placebo, in healthy, older volunteers in two consecutive trials and clinically significant improvements in patients with biomarker-positive mild AD. Previously, high levels of target engagement in the brain with doses as low as 5 mg daily have been demonstrated in a human PET imaging study. 

The Company is rapidly moving forward into its upcoming double-blind, randomized, placebo-controlled Phase 2 trials in cognitive impairment in Alzheimer’s Disease and Depression to further confirm and characterize Xanamem’s therapeutic potential. The XanaMIA Phase 2b AD trial comprises 330 patients with mild Alzheimer’s Disease and the XanaCIDD Phase 2a trial will total 160 patients with depression.

Description:
GlyTherix Ltd, is a targeted radiotherapy company with a clinical stage antibody product, Miltuximab, showing an excellent safety profile in high unmet need cancers. Miltuximab specifically targets GPC-1, a protein found on solid tumours such as prostate, bladder, pancreatic, glioblastoma, oesophageal and ovarian cancers, and is not present in healthy tissue. 

There is a large addressable market in the USA and Europe of US$21.7 billion per annum. The company has a strong proprietary and intellectual property position covering the Miltuximab antibody, epitope and the antigen. This provides robust and long-term protection for the commercialization of important new treatments to people with little hope.

Miltuximab precisely delivers targeted radiation to cancer cells. The company chelates a low energy 89Zirconium isotope to the antibody for diagnostic imaging. Image positive patients can then receive a dose of Miltuximab that is chelated to the high energy isotope 177Lutetium resulting in a cell destroying dose directly at the site of the cancer.  GlyTherix also has a pre-clinical program underway investigating the use of alpha particles, ie 225Actinium and 212Lead. 

GlyTherix has completed a ‘First-in-Human’ trial of 12 patients using Miltuximab with no drug-related adverse. events. Miltuximab will be used in both the Phase Ib and US Phase 2 trials as an antibody theranostic.

The company has entered an exclusive manufacturing, supply & distribution agreements with reliable isotope suppliers ANSTO and Cyclowest Holdings, both highly regarded nuclear medicine companies in Australia.  Agreements with US based CDMOs and isotope suppliers for our planned US trials are also in place.

GlyTherix has a strong management and research team and a highly experienced clinical advisory panel who have been intimately involved in commercialisation of targeted radiotherapies that are marketed in the US and elsewhere.

Description:
Optalert developed the world’s leading algorithm to quantify the deterioration in cognitive brain function due to drowsiness and created the Johns Drowsiness Scale (JDS) which  remains the only scientifically proven, objective measurement of drowsiness.

The JDS is used worldwide in research for accurately quantifying drowsiness levels, and in Optalert’s early-warning drowsiness detection systems to protect thousands of lives and valuable company assets across multiple industries. Our clients include BHP Billiton, Vale and NASA. Our research partners include the Harvard Medical School, Monash University, and the University of Queensland.

Optalert is a Medical Technology company pioneering the use of Blepharometry (the measurement of blinks) to measure drowsiness. Optalert discovered a key biomarker for drowsiness, the connection between brain function and eyelid movement.

Optalert is now turning its extensive expertise in Blepharometry and Artificial Intelligence to identify the biomarkers for other degradations to neurological brain function in conditions such as Epilepsy (due to onset of seizures), ADHD, Parkinson’s, Alzheimer’s, TBI, concussion and motor neuron disease.

Name: Misti
Description:
Misti is an Australian MedTech company pioneering MedMistiTM—a patented, hospital-grade smart inhaler designed for targeted lung delivery of advanced therapeutics.
Respiratory diseases such as asthma, COPD, influenza, COVID-19, and RSV continue to pose global health challenges, with poor adherence and device misuse undermining treatment outcomes. Traditional inhalers often clog, degrade sensitive molecules, and offer only short-term relief.
MedMistiTM overcomes these barriers with a breath-triggered, cloud-connected, clog-resistant design that increases deep lung delivery by 1.8x while preserving therapeutic integrity. The platform is engineered to deliver a wide range of biomolecules—including mRNA, antibodies, small molecules, and antigens—positioning it as a first-in-class solution for both chronic and infectious respiratory conditions.
Built for clinical-grade reliability and digital integration, MedMistiTM is redefining respiratory care through precision delivery, patient engagement, and global scalability.

Name: Ozgene
Description:
Ozgene is a global contract research organisation delivering end to end genetically engineered mouse model solutions for academic, biotechnology, and pharmaceutical researchers worldwide.

From custom model design and generation to breeding, genotyping, phenotyping, colony management, and vivarium operations, we provide integrated services that accelerate scientific discovery and drug development. Our proprietary goGermlineTM technology enables fast, reliable model generation with enhanced 3Rs compliance, while our OzBIG platform supports large genomic insertions and complex humanised mouse models.

With more than 25 years of experience and operations spanning Australia, the United States, and the Cayman Islands, Ozgene combines advanced model generation technologies with commercial breeding, embedded vivarium services, digital research infrastructure, and operational consulting to deliver flexible, scalable solutions.

We operate AAALAC accredited facilities in the United States and Australia, offer in sourced breeding and facility management services globally, and are the authorised distributor of JAX strains in Australia, New Zealand, and Indonesia, providing local access to high quality stock mice and rats.

Our global centres of expertise include:

 Perth, Australia: Custom humanized, knockout and knock in mouse model generation,  stock mouse and rat lines, breeding, validation, and preclinical research services.

 Indianapolis, USA: Custom breeding, genotyping, and vivarium services for academic, biotech, and pharmaceutical clients.

  Boston/Cambridge, USA: Embedded preclinical vivarium care, digitised workflows, and integration with client systems.

 George Town, Cayman Islands: Global consulting, operating model design, vivarium design and certification, digital systems, operational workflows, and infrastructure support.

 Munich, Germany: Scientific research project consulting, regional office.

Name: Sequins
Description: Sequins (sequencing spike-ins) are synthetic nucleic acid controls that directly mirror naturally occurring sequences. Our innovative design enables representation of almost any genomic feature, in any organism with a reference genome. Sequins retain the same nucleotide composition as the natural sequence and enable accurate representation of genomic complexity without compromising integrity of samples and results.

Name: BiomeCentric
Description:
Australia’s first 'BiomeCentric' contract manufacturer. 

We harness innovative manufacturing solutions and microbiome-centric technologies to bring your beauty, cosmetic and healthcare products to life.

We’re proud to be able to share our expertise and innovation to deliver purpose-filled, system-driven products that you can take to market with pride.

BiomeCentric develop products that challenge and beat the status quo. We’re passionate about helping our customers harness the value of microbiome-centric and organic ingredients through the delivery of innovative formulas to produce power-packed cosmetics, skincare, body care and healthcare products that make a difference. 

We want to support brands to broaden their thinking and unleash their potential to create life-enhancing products and challenges how products are applied and consumed. We strive to make a living difference to the ecosystems of our bodies and the world around us, creating a sustainable link and maintaining the health between these interconnected systems. 

BiomeCentric cultivates microbiome innovation through our state-of-the-art facility, which includes advanced bioprocessing and contract manufacturing capabilities. Our primary objectives encompass successfully commercialising novel biological active ingredients, as well as developing inventive product formulations and finished products that target both gut and skin microbiomes.

Name: Culturon
Description:
At CULTURON, we are redefining the foundation of life sciences with our plasma-treated surface technology — a breakthrough that overcomes one of research’s most persistent challenges: unreliable adhesion and reproducibility. By pioneering covalent binding at the surface level, CULTURON unlocks accurate, repeatable results across cell culture, diagnostics, and drug discovery.

CULTURON is a technology company with a defensible IP portfolio and a world-class scientific team, building a platform with applications across the entire life sciences ecosystem.

Why CULTURON Matters:

For Investors: CULTURON represents a scalable platform opportunity, addressing the multi-billion-dollar reproducibility crisis in life sciences. With proprietary IP, proven performance data, and a clear path to commercialisation, we are positioned for significant market adoption.

For Commercial Partners: Our technology provides a differentiated, IP-protected foundation for collaborative product development and market expansion.
For Academic Partners: We enable researchers to achieve more reliable, reproducible results — reducing wasted time and resources and opening new pathways for discovery.

For B2B Customers: CULTURON surfaces enhance accuracy and reliability in everyday workflows, from cell culture and assays to drug discovery and diagnostics.

Life Sciences, Transformed.

CULTURON’s mission is to provide the reliable foundation that science demands. By solving adhesion and reproducibility at the surface level, we empower researchers, accelerate discovery, and create commercial opportunities across the global life sciences landscape.

We invite investors, partners, and customers to join us in building the future of plasma-treated technologies — where every experiment, assay, and breakthrough rests on a surface that can finally be trusted.
Location: Sydney, Nsw, New South Wales, Australia

Name: MX3 Diagnostics
Description:
THE POWER OF A LAB IN THE PALM OF YOUR HAND

MX3 is changing what's possible for health diagnostics. This revolutionary platform is the first simple, reliable way to measure and track salivary and sweat biomarkers anytime, anywhere.

HYDRATION TRACKING SOLUTIONS

In a variety of markets – from health care to sports, military to mining – health and safety are vital to employee wellbeing and productivity. MX3’s emerging technology in health care provides point-of-care, immediate diagnostic solutions to one of the key markers of health and safety: hydration status.

MX3 Diagnostics’ revolutionary products offer the key to tracking and understanding hydration, offering point-of-care testing solutions to many common employee, workplace, and performance-related health concerns.

https://linktr.ee/mx3diagnostics

Name: Australian Biobest Biotechnology Service
ProAgni
Description: ProAgni develops innovative, trial-proven livestock supplements that improve animal performance without antibiotics.

Name: HaemaLogiX Ltd
Description: HaemaLogiX focus is the development and commercialisation of novel immuno-oncology and immune-therapies. HaemaLogiX is embarking on a program of several inter-related research and clincial development projects that will validate the antigen targets and products. We have a unique opportunity to develop effective treatments that improve the quality of life of patients suffering from blood cancers and autoimmune diseases.

Name: Kira Biotech Pty Ltd
Description: Kira Biotech is an emerging Australian biotechnology company developing novel immunomodulatory compounds for the treatment of immune system disorders.  Its lead candidate, KB312,  is a first-in-class, selective, immune-cell depleting monoclonal antibody which targets activated immune cells and aims to restore homeostasis through induction of immune tolerance.  Kira Biotech has attracted venture capital funding and is progressing KB312 through preclinical development and phase 1 clinical trials with a team of drug development experts led by well-known US-based rheumatologist and immunologist, Dr Dan Baker.

Name: ImmVirX
Description:
ImmVirX is an Australian company founded in 2019 with a mission to improve outcomes for patients with cancer types in which immunotherapy treatments have limited effect.  The company is developing a bio-selected RNA virus to induce tumour inflammation and achieve immune cell infiltration via the RIG-I pathway. The targets for this approach are Ovarian, Head & Neck and those indications which present with liver metastases such as Colorectal, Hepatocellular carcinoma and Pancreatic cancer. The approach includes combination therapy with Immune Checkpoint Inhibitors and CAR-T agents using bio-selected RNA virus.
The company founders, Malcolm McColl and Prof. Darren Shafren, were Managing Director and CSO of Viralytics, an ASX listed oncolytic virus company acquired in June 2018 by Merck and Co. Inc. for A$502 million.  The ImmVirX team includes key management and researchers from Viralytics and is based at the former Viralytics laboratory facilities in Newcastle Australia.
Location: New Lambton Heights, New South Wales, Australia

Name: Change Plastic for Good Ltd
Description: Plastic is one of the best inventions on earth. We wear it, drive in it, use endless products made with it and nothing can replace it. When we are done using it, it is a stubborn mess to manage. Our little butterfly logo represents a change in plastic for good and by giving a portion of profits to ocean cleanup programs, we help clean up the mess, past present and future.

Name: Winely
Description:
Winely is an AI-powered precision fermentation solution that optimises tradition, while deepening the connection between the winemaker and the wine by helping them unlock and understand the true depth of their vintages via real-time, deep learning-based data collection and analysis. Our technology produces wine whisperers, optimised artisans of their craft empowered by Cloud-based automation, artificial intelligence and IoT technologies. Leveraging the most universally accurate sensor on the market to deliver to-the-second data insights, Winely’s automation capabilities free up time, space, costs and manpower associated with the rote tasks of winemaking, thereby allowing vintners to return to their creativity while optimizing the wine they’ve already created. Our deep AI technology automatically and continuously generates live ferment data that can be accessed at any point from any mobile device, thereby drastically reducing the need for dangerous manual sampling, clarifying tank interventions and offering unmatched insights to winemakers. Winely is an Exocule company that shares its commitment to a cleaner future.

For some wineries, it takes 36 hours to produce data about actions that should have been taken 36 hours ago. Winely’s award-winning technology saves winemakers time, labor, manpower and money, while increasing safety and compliance by removing the need to manually retrieve and run lab samples during fermentation. This alone provides customers immediate ROI, with proven cost savings to the tune of $100,000 per year for savings on interventions and $450,000 per vintage for savings on labour. After four years of intensive research and development led by 155 bioscientists and researchers at the, Winely’s fifth-generation IoT sensors measure the most critical data sets for any given vintage while providing accurate data visualisation and predictive machine learning algorithms, thereby enabling the winemaker to make quick and easy decisions on interventions an

Description: Providing natural solutions to everyday agricultural problems by reducing the need for chemicals in our environment.

Name: Alloplex Biotherapeutics Inc
Description: Alloplex Biotherapeutics is dedicated to exploring the higher order combinatorial space of immunomodulators to develop an effective anti-tumor vaccine. This approach is applicable to all tumor types and is particularly suited to combinations with checkpoint inhibitors. Alloplex is a private company and currently supported by angel investment

Name: iCamuno Biotherapeutics Pty Ltd
Description: iCamuno starts with induced pluripotent stem cells (iPSCs) and uses cutting-edge technologies such as gene editing, and algorithm-driven cellular differentiation to empower cells. Guided by the philosophy of “demand-oriented, patient-centered”, we are changing the face of tumor immunotherapy and regenerative medicine, providing patients with universal, effective, and affordable cell therapies.

Name: Aculeus Therapeutics
Description:
Aculeus Therapeutics is a Biotech company based in Melbourne Australia, developing small molecule drugs that modulate the immune system for the treatment of cancer and other serious diseases. Aculeus is doing this by developing drugs that target the Stimulator of Interferon Genes (STING) biochemical pathway.

Aculeus in-licensed its lead programs, STING and ENPP1, in 2020 from the CRC for Cancer Therapeutics, a Public Private Partnership between a number of Australia’s leading Medical Research Institutes, Universities and Industry partners with a track record of scientific and commercial success.

Name: Canthera Discovery (Canthera Discovery Ltd)
Description:
Canthera Discovery is dedicated to Finding Cures for Cancer. 

We are a small molecule, oncology focused, drug discovery organisation that partners with leading Australian research institutes, universities and biotech companies.

We translate Australia’s cancer research into the next generation of gentler and more effective therapies for patients by bridging the gap between basic research and commercial outcomes.

We were established in 2007 under the Australian government’s Cooperative Research Centre (CRC) initiative.  Since our inception, we have licensed four preclinical candidates, and delivered two of the largest preclinical deals in Australia.  These deals have delivered $40 million in pharmaceutical revenue to the Australian economy with the potential to grow in excess of $600 million long-term.

We have executed three collaborative cancer research deals with international pharmaceutical companies such as Pfizer, MSD and Amplia.

Name: Sypharma Pty Ltd
Description:
Sypharma offers contract manufacturing services to the pharmaceutical, veterinary and consumer goods industries, with a specialist program for clinical trial material and drug development. As Sypharma expands its chemical and microbiological laboratories we can increasingly offer extra laboratory services. We provide you with a broad range of formulations, batch sizes, and packaging formats to accommodate your requirements. Our Fully GMP licensed manufacturing facility is centrally located in Melbourne's South Eastern business area enabling logistical ease for distribution.

We offer a cost effective option, with production capability, manufacturing flexibility and most importantly, our commitment to quality ensures that your product complies with current licensing standards. Sypharma can provide all or part of the support services associated with production, testing, and release-for-sale of human and veterinary pharmaceutical products and consumer goods.

Sypharma is licensed to aseptically Fill and Finish for Phase I, II and III Clinical Trials, and specialises in small run manufacturing.

Sypharma offers a complete solution to your Drug Development needs, and can provide services from R & D through to commercial supply.  We are also happy to provide facility rental with our trained GMP operators for assistance.

Name: Natural MedTech
Description: Natural MedTech is manufacturing psychedelic medicines to unlock neurologic potential. We are building Australia’s leading pure-play psychedelic business, with differentiated IP, an experienced team, and a self-funding growth profile.

Name: Psykinetic
Description:
Psykinetic is a Sydney based social business creating futuristic, inclusive and empowering technologies to improve independence and quality of life for people with disabilities. We are dedicated towards building a truly inclusive society, and we want to work with you on this journey.

Our three flagship products: 
- StarGaze: A platform that houses the world’s first software marketplace for eye-controlled, and soon to be switch-operated and alternative interface systems; 
- Frontier: eye-controlled communication keyboard with three levels of graduating functionality and speed;
- Atmosphere: eye-controlled music software that allows a musician to play instruments, record and layer tracks for their own musical creations.

We have big plans for the future, and have created proof-of-concepts for thought-controlled smart wheelchairs to even vehicles as demonstrated in Dr Jordan Nguyen’s multiple award-winning documentary ‘Becoming Superhuman’ with ABC and the Feds.

StarGaze, Frontier and Atmosphere are available to download today at www.psykinetic.com/stargazedownload.

Name: Accelerating Australia
Description:
Accelerating Australia was a consortium of 20 organisations nationally within the MedTech, Biotech and Pharmaceutical sectors. The aim of the project was to encourage commercialisation within the MTP sector by improving coordination and collaboration as well as improving workforce skills necessary for future market needs.

This venture received funding through the MTPConnect Project Fund Program – a dollar-for-dollar matched program investing in big, bold ideas to boost Australia’s medical technology, biotechnology and pharmaceutical sector, supported by the Australian Government Industry Growth Centres Initiative – learn more at mtpconnect.org.au

The legacy of Accelerating Australia was the support of Biodesign Australia (biodesign.au), SPARK Oceania (sparkglobal.io/locations/spark-oceania/) and CERI (ceri.org.au) during a crucial period in their development, and their activities go from strength to strength!

Name: bio-az
Description:
Inspired by the connection between our microbiome and nature, bio-az scientists have developed breakthrough technology to produce the world’s best functional ingredients.

We believe wellness should be easy, simple, and affordable for everyone, every day. 

Our innovations and biotechnology remodel formulations to yield higher nutritional efficacy, optimising functional ingredients, transforming ordinary everyday consumables into wellness performance products.

Welcome to bio-az!

Name: DNA SOLUTIONS
Description:
DNA Solutions have been assisting individuals around the globe with DNA Paternity & relationship analysis & were the first pioneering company offering DNA home kits to test for paternity and introduced these back in the 90’s. 
Many of our technical staff and management are ex-police and ex-military DNA testing forensic scientists, further enhancing the quality and range of our DNA tests. Processing occurs in our own DNA laboratory, our lab is capable of DNA ancestry testing, paternity testing, relationship tests, DNA banking and preservation, where we additionally carry out extensive research and development. 
We have offices and laboratories worldwide &
serve thousands of individuals and organizations globally

Name: Sydney University Association of Biomedical Engineers (SUABE)
Description:
The Sydney University Association of Biomedical Engineers was founded in 2004 on the initiative of Professor Andrew Ruys. It was seen that a body should be set up to represent the biomedical engineering students on campus, a group that is becoming almost exponentially larger with each year.

At SUABE, we aim to foster the social and professional development of our student members, with the ultimate goal of furthering their understanding and appreciation for the biomedical industry. We endeavour to bridge the divide between industry personnel and university students in a manner that is mutually beneficial for both parties.

Name: GLIA Diagnostics Pty Ltd
Description:
GLIA Diagnostics (GLIA) is dedicated to transforming the diagnosis and prognosis of traumatic brain injury (TBI), with a particular emphasis on mild TBI (mTBI)/concussion, to deliver better outcomes for patients worldwide. Our mission is to advance the understanding of brain injury through rigorous research, education, and the clinical validation of a novel biomarker suite. When integrated into a purpose-built point-of-care (POC) device, this platform will provide an objective and reliable tool for both diagnosis and prognosis.
Our multidisciplinary team works closely with leading medical and scientific experts across the globe. By conducting robust clinical trials in diverse patient cohorts, we aim to validate our biomarker panel in parallel with complementary diagnostic modalities—establishing a comprehensive, evidence-based solution for concussion and broader TBI management.
With proven expertise in biomedical science, diagnostics, translational research, and device development, GLIA is uniquely positioned to lead innovation in this critical field. We are building GLIA as a collaborative hub, bringing together synergistic partners across Australasia and internationally. We believe the future of TBI diagnostics will be defined by integrated biomarker panels and multimodal approaches, enabling precise, real-time decision-making in both clinical practice and frontline environments.

Name: ARC ENTO TECH LTD
Description:
ARC Ento Tech Ltd. is an Australian biotechnology company that aims to address the pressing global problem of mixed solid waste. 

Redefining the "waste" into a "resource", and through our patent-pending ARC ProcessTM - end of life waste streams are recovered, reformed and repurposed into new sustainable and commercially viable commodities.
Location: Central Coast, New South Wales, Australia

Name: Messenger Bio
Description:
Messenger Bio is industrializing the discovery of mRNA medicines. Our goal is to pioneer life-changing medicines for the treatment of genetic brain diseases, and to help other research discovery teams leverage the power of mRNA technology for themselves. We have >30 institutional customers in 10 countries.

Check us out: www.messenger.bio

Name: UNSW Recombinant Products Facility
Description: The RPF is embedded within the Bioscience precint at the University of NSW in Sydney. It provides expertise in protein expression and purification. The facility is located within a newly commissioned OGTR PC2 facility. The facility has access to state-of-the art capabilities in protein expression, purification and analysis.

Name: AliveX Biotech
Description: AliveX Biotech is a leading AI + multi-omics technology platform company. Our mission is to accelerate the discovery and effective therapies that improve therapy outcomes worldwide. We facilitate this through leveraging our multi-omics data generation capabilities, proprietary data, AI/ML analytics and knowledge-empowered modeling for a deeper understanding of biological systems.

Name: Prana Biotechnology
Description: Prana Biotechnology is now Alterity Therapeutics. This page is no longer being administered.

Name: Myopharm Limited
Description:
Myopharm Limited is a full-suite diabetes focussed clinical-stage Australian-based biopharmaceutical company, developing targeted therapies for Type 1 & Type 2 diabetes. 

In our portfolio we have pharmaceutical drug candidates & clinically validated consumer health products.

Our lead drug asset TriGlytza IND approved and we are focussed on developing first-in-class, novel therapeutics and consumer products for the treatment and prevention of Type 2 diabetes. 

Myopharm is currently developing a number of diabetes therapeutics including a beta-cell-centric triple combination drug, to address the 50% antidiabetic treatment failures occurring in Type 2 diabetics. 

Right now, there are no anti-inflammatory 'Beta-cell-centric' therapies on the market for Type 2 diabetes. Our novel & innovative beta-cell centric product, RK-01 or TriGlytza restored the efficacy of Metformin in C57BL/6J DIO mice with insulin resistance and pancreatic beta-cell dysfunction. We are on track to bring TriGlytza to market by 2027.

https://www.myopharm.com

Name: Tréidlia Biovet
Description: Tréidlia Biovet is an Australian specialist in Veterinary Biotechnology, developing and manufacturing Specialty Veterinary Vaccines and performing R&D and Diagnostic Services. We partner with veterinarians, companies and researchers to solve problems in animal health using an array of microbiological techniques. Treidlia BioVet has developed and manufactures a wide range of innovative, customised vaccines for livestock (including fish) and companion animals. These specialty vaccines make a targeted contribution to solving problems in Animal Health and Environmental Protection. We provide technical expertise that spans bacterial, recombinant and viral vaccines and our manufacturing facility is GMP certified. Other work areas involve products for food safety, conservation of endangered species and control of feral animals. If you have an animal health problem that needs solving and you are looking for a committed partner to assist you please contact us on info@treidlia.com.au or +61 2 9674 1488. For more information see www.treidlia.com.au
Location: Seven Hills, New South Wales, Australia

Name: Biotest Laboratories
Description:
Biotest was established in 1989 to provide expert scientific services to food, pharmaceutical and biological manufacturers.

Biotest believe its success is based on strong service delivery, outstanding people and knowledge of the technical and regulatory challenges facing manufacturers.

We believe our broad customer base and 100's of contract arrangements with clients with many enduring relationships, attests to our performance.

Biotest offers analytical chemical and microbiological testing services, cGMP auditing, consulting and training services.  Through our Clean room facility we provide cGMP production of biologicals including stem cells.

Description:
ParagonCare Scientific represents names that you know and quality brands that you trust.

Providing access to a range of quality laboratory essential equipment and consumables, we are far more than a reseller. We are your distribution partner, dedicated to the supply and technical support for reliable solutions locally.

Name: VFV Pty Ltd
Description:
VFV is a manufacturer and distributor of fluid handling and process control products and systems for a wide range of Industrial, Life Science and High Purity applications. We supply engineering support, product selection advice, and application specific product training to help customers create and implement fit-for-purpose solutions, every time.

We represent market-leading manufacturers, offering comprehensive solutions for hundreds of industries whom depend on gas or fluid systems to power their businesses.  

VFV is a creative and dedicated team of engineers, designers and industry specialists who work alongside customers right from the design phase to provide fast, accurate and proven solutions.

Description: A leading provider of Life Science data, products and services to the Agricultural, mining, consumer and industrial sectors in Australia, USA, Japan and Southern Africa.

Name: UNSW Bioinformatics Society
Description: UNSW Bioinformatics Society (BINFSOC) is built on the values of connecting, educating and inspiring students to discover what it means to study bioinformatics. Being a field that incorporates computer science, statistics, biology and engineering, our mission is to cultivate multidisciplinary future thinkers and innovators from all corners of STEM. Whether it be through networking with leading research and industry representatives, skills and career workshops, competitions or our social events, BINFSOC strives to build a supportive student community!

Name: Etiscope
Description:
The award winning team of work safety professionals at JointAction Group are proud to introduce Etiscope. Etiscope provides you with the fastest and most accurate WMSD risk analysis technology on the market.

Etiscope is backed by a team of ergonomists, researchers, medical, work health & safety, data scientists and technical experts committed to assisting businesses proactively reduce MSD injuries in the workplace.

Name: Sydney University Society of Medical Innovation (SUSMI)
Description: We are a student-led society founded in 2019 with the intention of creating and driving a movement for medical innovation in the medical industry. The Sydney University Society of Medical Innovation (SUSMI) is a multidisciplinary society that aims to bring together students studying all degrees. The goal of SUSMI is to create change in the current medical field by helping our members realise their own potential for innovation and creativity.

Name: Beta Cell Technologies
Description: Beta Cell Technologies (Beta Cell) is an emerging biotech company located in Adelaide, South Australia, founded by Professor Toby Coates, Professor John Greenwood AM and Mr Julian Burton OAM. Beta Cell is committed to developing pioneering methodologies to treat endocrine deficiency disorders, such as type 1 diabetes (T1D), and is now in the early stages of designing, developing and implementing a novel, Intracutaneous Ectopic (IEP) Pancreas to treat T1D on a global scale.

Name: Banksia Scientific Company
Description:
Since our humble beginnings in 1980, Banksia Scientific has been a supplier to the scientific and medical community across Australia, New Zealand and the Pacific Islands. 

In 2004 we relocated to larger more efficient premises in Auckland and Brisbane and in 2005 we opened up our Sydney office which enabled us to provide our customers with a far more effective service further enhancing our reputation that other suppliers aspire to.

A true measure of any sales organisations success is the percentage of repeat orders received and recommendations passed on and we are proud to declare an exceptionally high level of such success in this area. We aim to please and will strive to supply you with the products that you require at a sensible price, a decent level of quality and within a suitable time frame.

We look forward to working with our existing customers and partners and expanding our customer base throughout the territories and providing them with the same high level of service and friendly help that our customers have become accustomed to.

We would like to thank all our previous customers for your support over the past 28 years and we look forward to an exciting future with many new ventures. Please feel free to contact any of our staff to see how we can help you come to a better result for your laboratory.

Banksia Scientific’s Head Office is in Bulimba, Queensland, Australia and incorporates our Australian based sales team, accounts department, orders department (both export and local) and a warehouse where most of our supplies are shipped from. The senior management is also based here with hands-on involvement in all areas of the company.

Our New Zealand office is based in Auckland and incorporates our New Zealand based sales team along with the warehouse and logistics for the National orders. All stock for our New Zealand customers is held in Auckland to allow for an overnight delivery to all areas.

Name: BIODE Pty Ltd
Description:
We are a team of BIOMETRIC EXPERTS, leading the industry through software innovations to protect people and physical assets within Government and Commercial organisations.

BIODE was founded on decades of biometric experience, and our specialised solutions continue to protect many of Australia's most trusted companies.

We've come a long way over the past 20 years, but we're just getting started!

Bioarc is a medicinal cannabis company focused on cultivar development for improved agronomics and therapeutic qualities.

Name: Gemini Biotechnology
Imunexus Therapeutics Limited
Description:
Imunexus Therapeutics Limited (Imunexus) is an Australian biologics company, founded in 2020 and focused exclusively on the development of multispecific therapeutics, including bispecific and trispecific antibodies and multispecific therapeutic enzymes. 

The imunexinTM platform, enables existing biologic drugs, such as monoclonal antibodies and therapeutic enzymes, to be converted into multispecific molecules by genetically fusing additional functional protein modules (imunexinsTM) while preserving the parent drug’s original structure and activity.

Name: easyDNA Australia
Description:
EasyDNA is an international DNA testing company that specializes  in offering reliable, accurate and confidential testing services to both the private and public sector all over the world. The founders of EasyDNA have been involved in this industry for over ten years and have capitalized on this experience to develop EasyDNA into a leading DNA testing service provider. EasyDNA now operates through an international network of offices in over twenty countries. 
Our quality promise
At EasyDNA the quality of our service is of utmost importance. We offer high quality tests through our internationally accredited laboratory that is backed by a team of highly experienced scientists. Our laboratory has in fact performed over 250,000 DNA tests over the years and therefore it has the necessary experience to handle a wide range of differing cases.

At EasyDNA we also offer excellent levels of customer service. We understand that ordering a DNA test can be a very sensitive and trying experience, and therefore we are constantly at hand to provide you with all the information you require and to guide you through the process on a step-by-step basis. 

EasyDNA has also featured in a number of TV programs, soap operas and radio interviews. Moreover, the company’s services where also requested to help solve high-brow DNA testing cases involving well-known people. To read more about this, visit our media page.
An extensive portfolio of tests

At EasyDNA we offer a diverse portfolio of DNA testing services to cover a wide range of cases. Whilst our most common test remains the home paternity test, we also offer extensive DNA relationship testing including twin zygosity testing, that can help determine a wide range of relationships. In addition, our experienced DNA forensic team is able to offer state-of-the-art DNA forensic services, enabling us to process a wide variety of samples ranging from hair and blood to teeth and bones.

Name: The Research Collab
Description: The Research Collab makes research more efficient by matching researchers with projects. Post and search for projects online to find co-researchers, recruit extra clinical sites and publish your papers faster. We also have a database of grants and a section on ‘how to research’.

Name: IMPACT BioTech
Description:
Engineered nature-based solutions based upon, and enhanced by, science and ‘real’ data. We deliver accelerated plant based global agricultural, environmental, climate and economic solutions utilising our proprietary plant biotechnology capability.

We deliver genetically stable (non GMO) plant performance enhancements for plant based businesses, plant/nature based solutions and bioengineered environmental projects.

Our key focus is on bioremediation of contaminated and marginal lands, avoidance and reversal of desertification, vegetative and soil carbon sequestration, ecosystem and biodiversity preservation and assisted by realising the full potential of industrial hemp solutions for global repair and sustainability.

We guarantee a favourable IMPACT upon the nature-positive economy!

Name: Ascend Biopharmaceuticals Ltd
Description:
Ascend is a cancer immunotherapy company developing medicines to treat primary, recurrent and metastatic cancers. Cancers are made up of many different cell types that can influence and regulate the local tumour microenvironment to promote tumour growth.  Ascend’s strategy focuses on targeting these key cells and altering the host microenvironment from one that supports tumour growth to one that results in cancer eradication.

The company applies a number of different technologies and approaches utilizing viral vectors, and affinity agents that can be conjugated to deliver biologicals and small molecule (immune modulators, kinase inhibitors or chemotherapeutics) payloads. We believe that applying a combination chemotherapy and immunotherapy (chemo-immunotherapy) approach has the potential to materially improve therapeutic outcomes.

Name: Ondek
Description:
Ondek is an Australian biotechnology company developing natural immune modulatory products, where there is a large global market opportunity in allergic disorders.

Ondek is developing its novel allergy products as natural and safe remedies with supporting efficacy data. The target indication is childhood eczema and other products will address food allergies and allergic asthma in children, adolescents and adults.

Ondek was founded by Professor Barry Marshall, a world authority and co-discoverer of the Helicobacter pylori organism and co-recipient of the 2005 Nobel Prize for Medicine and Physiology.

Name: Advangen
Description:
Advangen develops scientifically validated hair loss products to treat various forms of hair loss. Advangen only sells products that have a well understood mechanism of action and been proven to work by independent scientific testing. Advangen’s discovery and product development processes are the same ones used to identify and test new medicines for treating human disease. 

Advangen’s products are placed under the same rigour and scrutiny normally reserved for pharmaceuticals and their mechanism of action is the subject of scientific publications. That is why we can confidently vouch for the safety and effectiveness of all our products.

Name: Anthrocell Pty Ltd

Name: HAVAH Therapeutics
Description:
HavaH’s mission is to develop therapies with reduced side effects and early prevention of breast cancers including hormonal refractory ER+ breast cancer and metastatic cancer. HavaH is developing innovative, proprietary hormonal therapies that aim to improve quality of life for women across the world. Name: Dendright Pty Limited
Description:
Dendright is a clinical-stage biotechnology company developing DEN-181, a first-in-class tolerizing  immunotherapy for the treatment of rheumatoid arthritis. 

DEN-181  targets the underlying cause of the disease rather than treating its inflammatory symptoms. It is a nanoparticle-based immunotherapy designed to regulate activated immune cells which cause inflammation, pain and joint damage in rheumatoid arthritis.  Laboratory studies have shown that activated immune cells can be regulated in an antigen-specific manner through nanoparticle delivered signals. DEN-181 has the potential to offer higher specificity of effect and lower toxicity than current treatments for RA given the lack of broadly suppressive effects on the immune system. 

Dendright entered into a R&D Collaboration and Option to License Agreement with Janssen Biotech, Inc. in 2013 which was extended in 2017. In 2017, Dendright entered into an agreement with Arthritis Queensland to also contribute funding to the clinical program. 

Dendright’s core technology patent, which describes the particulate co-delivery of target antigens and NF-kB inhibitors to immune cells, was granted by the United States Patent and Trademark Office (USPTO) as US Patent Application 12/444,790 in 2015. Dendright has also secured the grant of related patents in Australia, Canada and China. 

The founding technology was discovered and developed by Professor Ranjeny Thomas at the University of Queensland Diamantina Institute. Dendright is a start-up company of UniQuest, the technology transfer and commercialisation company of the University of Queensland.
